summary_en: Cosmo Bio will acquire the remaining 32.18% stake in BM Kiki through a simplified share exchange, issuing 114,716 treasury shares (approximately 2.01% of outstanding shares) to SBIC. The exchange is scheduled to become effective on December 25, 2026, without requiring shareholder approval due to simplified exchange procedures.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Acquisition of Consolidated Subsidiary (BM Kiki Co., Ltd.) through Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Cosmo Bio Co., Ltd. announced that its Board of Directors has approved a simplified share exchange to make BM Kiki Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary. BM Kiki, established in 1985, supplies laboratory and medical precision equipment and has been a consolidated subsidiary with Cosmo Bio holding 67.82% of voting rights. The remaining 32.18% is held by Tokyo Small and Medium Enterprise Investment & Consultation Co., Inc. (SBIC) through Series 1 preferred shares.

Under the simplified share exchange, Cosmo Bio will issue 114,716 ordinary shares to SBIC in exchange for SBIC's shares in BM Kiki. These shares will be drawn from Cosmo Bio's treasury stock (350,079 shares as of September 30, 2026) with no new issuance of shares. The acquisition represents approximately 2.01% of Cosmo Bio's outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The exchange is scheduled to become effective on December 25, 2026.

Cosmo Bio stated that the complete acquisition aligns with its Medium-Term Business Plan 2028 and aims to accelerate decision-making within the group, improve efficiency through business integration, and strengthen operational coordination to enhance enterprise value. Because this is a simplified share exchange involving a consolidated subsidiary, Cosmo Bio is not required to obtain shareholder approval under the Companies Act.
